family_reports.body: There are serious concerns about how Karl Hays and his appointed GALs such as Tahlia Stewart approach these cases. It often feels as though reports of abuse are met with skepticism rather than careful consideration, and that the legal process is being shaped to fit a specific narrative rather than the full set of facts. It is deeply troubling to see any position of authority used in a way that could undermine trust in the process.
Completely took the side of the mother without giving me a chance to give my side of the story. Mother has lied on multiple affidavits and under oath in court multiple times.
Sad that this is allowed to happen time and time again- no accountability for the family court system

public_comments.comment_text: She forced us to weekly visits that my child would refuse to go in. She invited the child's abuser to attend without notice. She failed to report disclosed abuse to CPS. She continued to bill for sessions after sessions were stopped. Would not allow cancelations and would bill excessive fees for no shows. Extremely cold, rigid and not welcoming. She gets family court cases to require sessions, and just does everything she can to keep you on the payroll. We attended weekly for 2 years and my child hated every session and would refuse to speak with her. She would get personally offended when my child would refuse. She failed to report abuse. Worked with criminal defense attorney, and Amicus to secretly bring the abuser into therapy. Continued to charge after visits stopped. Would act like a child and be personally offended when my child did not want to talk to her.
public_comments.author: Anonymous parent

public_comments.comment_text: Led me on for more than a year with absolutely zero effort in actually reuniting my children and I. Was not lacking in billing me immediately for everything she possibly could bill for. Kept telling me to admit to something I didn't do. Took the mother's side just like everyone else involved in the reunification process.
